title: Intelligence as Infrastructure: How AI Is Rewiring the Economy
description: Leon Shaulov, Founder, Maplelane Capital and Alex Sacerdote, Founder, CEO and Portfolio Manager, Whale Rock Capital Management in conversation at Sohn Investment Conference 2026. Moderated by CNBC's Leslie Picker.
summary: The speaker argues that AI is fundamentally rewiring the economy, creating significant opportunities in foundational models, data infrastructure, and semiconductor manufacturing. They view Google as a simple, cheap buy that has successfully won the AI race with a foundational model, potentially offering substantial upside. Additionally, the pitch highlights Texas Instruments and Lam Research as favorites, citing Lam's high exposure to memory and expected spending booms, while noting that big model companies like Anthropic rely on DataDog's tools.

claims.claim: The speaker views Google as a simple, cheap buy that has won AI, possesses a foundational model, and could easily be up 50-50%.
claims.quote: the second one is just Google. It's simple. They've won AI. They're the only public company with a foundational model. Their Google TPU chips are phenomenal. They're now powering Anthropic, and other people are using them besides Google. Uh search is actually getting accelerated, and they've got so many other assets like YouTube and Gmail and Google Sheet. They're going to infuse AI. The stock is very cheap, and we're going to see revenues accelerate at Google. So it could easily be up 50 50%. I don't see very much downside.

claims.claim: The speaker explicitly states they like Texas Instruments very good.
claims.quote: I think Texas Instruments is very good.

claims.claim: The speaker describes DataDog as a unique asset at the heart of benefiting from everything happening in AI.
claims.quote: I look at a company like DataDog, that's a unique asset. Right? We can again, is it 30 times or 40 times? The market will kind of get that, but they are at the heart of actually benefiting from everything that's happening.

claims.claim: The speaker notes that big model companies like Anthropic are using DataDog's tools, which serves as a good tell for the company.
claims.quote: Um Leon mentioned Datadog. You know, a lot of the big model companies like Anthropic are using Datadog's tools. So that's also pretty good tell.
